This is one workstation transfer only; spoken-language semantics, full DUB transfer, captions and native phone/offline acceptance remain unverified.

Bounded search, details, numbered episode identity and MP4Upload SUB resolution; exact HTTPS media origin and port, no downloaded JavaScript execution.
